# Ukiyo

Ukiyo tightens the Obsidian interface to reduce excess whitespace and keep note content central. It provides Smooth and Minimal display modes, a choice of colour schemes that can also be crafted by the user, slide animations for pop-out callouts, and side panels that float above the content.

![Ukiyo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/technerium/obsidian-ukiyo/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ukiyo"
    author: "technerium"
    repo:   "technerium/obsidian-ukiyo"
    slug:   "ukiyo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ukiyo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/technerium/obsidian-ukiyo"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/technerium/obsidian-ukiyo/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Streamline your Obsidian interface to reduce excess whitespace and keep notes front and center. Switch between Smooth and Minimal display modes, pick or craft color schemes, enable slide animations for pop-out callouts, and float side panels above content."
}
```
